input.quote: 4.3 Ownership of the Wet Segment shall be as shown in Schedule B to this Agreement. The Wet Segment of APCN 2 shall be owned by the Parties in common and undivided shares.
input.rationale: This is a consortium cable construction and capacity agreement, so "ownership" here is asset-based rather than deliverables/IP-based, and it runs in our favour. Under §4.3/§12.2 and §12.16 we own Segment and capacity interests in proportion to our financial investment per Schedules B and C — i.e. we own what we pay for — and §12.4-12.27 give us unrestricted rights to assign circuits and sell IRU capacity out of our Allocated Capacity, so the tenancy-in-common structure is not walk-away joint ownership. There is no assignment or transfer of any Teleglobe intellectual property, work product or data to the other APCN 2 Parties anywhere in the document (searches for intellectual property, software, title, and grant return nothing adverse), and §31 Confidentiality restricts other Parties' use and disclosure of data we supply. Noted but not flagged: the Agreement contains no express IP or data-ownership article and no licence-back mechanic, because the Wet Segment is procured under a separate Supply Contract with Suppliers (§4.4); this is a wording gap of the preferred position, not a material failure, since nothing here divests us of any IP or data rights.
